summary: Short kerb beside a speed hump; homes 14-16 m away, gentle climb.
reasons: No parked cars seen on this kerb

best_section.where: East kerb of Taringa Parade just south of the raised speed hump

drivers.seclusion: Trees and a garden hedge screen the kerb; nearest mapped dwellings 14 m (at 11 m) and 16 m (at 0 m); bush lies across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane with a narrow grassy edge; room to stop at the kerb for one van, no gate or barrier.
drivers.traffic: Through street with moderate traffic and a speed hump beside the section.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on this kerb in the images; one car parked on the road ahead near the houses.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on the same side
sun_shade: Tree cover on the east side shades the kerb in the morning; open to afternoon sun over the road.
